items.why: The report lists extra bands only for flake B at 4 K ("bands at 247.3, 342.6, 358.9, 361.0") and only two bands for A at 4 K and both 300 K spectra, but it never calls them low-temperature extra features, never reports the ~220 cm-1 Ag2 shoulder, and never compares the flakes on this point.
Nothing in the report concludes which flake is few-layer and which is bulk-like.
The report never mentions magnetic ordering, TN or spin-phonon coupling.
It gives the numbers ("strongest band of flake A, 4 K shifts by -1.31 cm-1 in flake B, 4 K"; 250.0 vs 247.3 cm-1), but it does not identify the modes as Ag2/Ag3 or link the redshift to layer number.

The fitted positions show both bands higher at 4 K than at 300 K in both flakes, and it states a -3.63 cm-1 shift for flake A, but there is no explicit statement that both modes harden on cooling in both flakes.
The caveats list is empty, and nothing is said about intensities, baselines or the different export processing.
The questions_for_user list is empty, so there is no request for AFM thickness or intermediate temperatures.

wrong_claims.why: The report lists only two bands for flake A at 4 K and never attributes extra modes to flake A.
The report makes no claim about which flake is thinner.
